text: The library's own stream helpers honour the in-flight signal: takeUntilResult() passes a result carrying a non-empty backgroundTasks list and stops only at the terminal one, so a consumer using it observes the background_task_completed and the continuation turn rather than the bug the signal exists to prevent.
